title: Coefficient tensor normalization on flat K-flat representatives
statement: For flat-term K-flat representatives P,Q, coefficient reduction of the ordinary ringed tensor representative, followed by the prescribed tensor comparison and the tensor of the reduction model maps, is the strict reduction tensor map followed by the recorded system tensor representative. This is exactly the displayed mu_model equation. The module also constructs the two natural paths, their common isomorphism pre/post factors, and the localized ordinary left/right paths used to normalize them.

proof.text: Use K-flat total tensor preservation and geometric inverse-image preservation of flat K-flat representatives. The tensorRepresentative equation identifies the ringed tensor model with the integral calculus tensor model. Apply the existing strict reduction derived square. The system model naturality is its defining natural-isomorphism naturality. The pre/post factors are functors applied to isomorphisms and tensor products of isomorphisms; their inverses are given by the corresponding iso inverses. The two abstract pasting lemmas use associativity alone.

lean.statement:
theorem mu_model (d : RingedModels l E) (W : Scheme.{u})
    (P Q :
      (proEtaleFlatRepresentatives W ((PurCompactSupport.completed l E).ring W)).FullSubcategory) :
    (calculus l E W).reduction.map
        ((d.tensor W).ordinary.representative.hom.app (P, Q)) ≫
      (mu l E d W).app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P.obj, DerivedCategory.Q.obj Q.obj) ≫
      (calculus l E W).systemClosed.tensor.map
        (Prod.mkHom ((pullbackTensorReductionModel l E W).hom.app
          ⟨P.obj, (d.tensor W).good P.obj P.property⟩)
          ((pullbackTensorReductionModel l E W).hom.app
            ⟨Q.obj, (d.tensor W).good Q.obj Q.property⟩)) =
    (pullbackTensorReductionModel l E W).hom.app
        ⟨(total l E W).obj (P.obj, Q.obj), total_good l E W
          ⟨P.obj, (d.tensor W).good P.obj P.property⟩
          ⟨Q.obj, (d.tensor W).good Q.obj Q.property⟩⟩ ≫
      DerivedCategory.Q.map (tensorReductionStrictMap l E W P.obj Q.obj) ≫
      (pullbackTensorSystemModel l E W _ _
        (pullbackTensorReductionGood l E W ⟨P.obj, (d.tensor W).good P.obj P.property⟩)
        (pullbackTensorReductionGood l E W ⟨Q.obj, (d.tensor W).good Q.obj Q.property⟩)).hom
